paper_title: Axion search with quantum nondemolition detection of magnons
notes: QND magnon detection with superconducting qubit + YIG. Upper limit g_aee < 2.6e-6 at 95% CL over 33.117-33.130 ueV. Uses rho_DM=0.45 GeV/cm^3 and vtot=220 km/s.
